name: Copilot Studio topics
short_description: Designed portions of a Copilot Studio agent conversation with steps, questions and conditions, used for answers that must be exact; requests outside the topics can fall back to generated answers.

evidence.quote: a topic is a portion of a conversation with steps, questions
Topics are where you put the answers that must be exact

You can define topics. These are custom conversation flows for specific scenarios
Start with topics because topics are still the cleanest way to make a path repeatable when the outcome matters.
A topic in co-pilot studio is essentially a conversation blueprint, a series of steps the agent executes when triggered.
